game_concept: A card battler set in The Kingdom – Mill Stream, a stream-side windmill: the baker's apprentice must handle thieves while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Memory Map: Place variable cards on a memory board so the royal vault reads the right value at run time.
theme: The Kingdom – Mill Stream: a stream-side windmill
core_gameplay_loop: In Mill Stream, repeat each round: Place variable cards on a memory board so the royal vault reads the right value at run time. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the y value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about y to power up the baker's apprentice and open the royal vault.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 8 (extended tier): Memory Map
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Memory Map' (Week 1 slot 9), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Mill Stream'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how y changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thieves in Mill Stream.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 9.
